app.title: CollabPad — the living canvas
app.description: A shared world where drawings come alive. Draw, loop it and press ALIVE.
landing.title: Draw it — and it comes alive.
landing.lead: One big world for everyone. Draw anything, loop your drawing and press ALIVE: the cow goes grazing, the wolf goes hunting, and the bomb blows up.
landing.note: Free, no sign-up. Every stroke stays forever.
canvas.label: Shared world for drawing
canvas.frozen: This world is paused: the host's subscription has ended
alive.hint: Draw a loop around the drawing you want to bring to life.
goo.title: Coming alive…

control.unbound: This remote isn't linked — draw a car nearby
share.empty: It's just you here — invite friends
gate.title: Hey! Sorry, but all this costs money
gate.body: Bringing drawings to life runs on neural networks and servers, and ads keep the free world open. Turn off your ad blocker for collabpad.ru — or try Plus:
gate.perks: ✓ no ads · ✓ private worlds with role-based access · ✓ more ✨ revivals
gate.retry: I turned it off — check again

account.title: Sign in to CollabPad
account.lead: We'll e-mail you a one-time link. No password needed.
account.consent: I agree to my e-mail address being stored and used to sign me in
account.privacy: We store only your e-mail address and language. We use them to sign you in and to send invitations and payment notices. Nothing else, and no marketing.
account.sent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and for 15 minutes.
account.badEmail: That doesn't look like an e-mail address
account.plusUntil: Plus is cancelled and stays active until {date}.
account.noWorlds: No private worlds yet. Name one to create it.
account.worldsNeedPlus: Private worlds come with Plus. Worlds you're invited to will show up here.

share.addedNoMail: {email} now has access, but the e-mail couldn't be sent — share the link yourself
plans.title: Plans
plans.plus.worlds: Up to 5 private worlds with access by link or account and roles
plans.plus.guests: Guests join your worlds for free
plans.redirecting: Taking you to the payment page…
plans.note: Payment goes through YooKassa. Prices are in Russian rubles. If a subscription ends, private worlds are paused, never deleted.
